description: This source file implements a reactive component system similar to React using Lua. It defines state management with useState, two application components App and App2 that handle button clicks and display counters, and uses custom functions for rendering and event handling.

methods.name: useState
methods.description: Custom implementation of a state hook, managing state per component instance with getter and setter functions.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main reactive component with buttons to increment counters and render UI elements.

methods.name: App2
methods.description: Secondary component similar to App, with independent counters.
